name: Hiver Omni
description:
Connect your Shared Inboxes in Hiver Omni to Claude to quickly find the conversations you need, understand the context behind customer issues, and take actions like drafting responses, adding tags and internal notes, updating a CRM record, or creating a task in your project management tool.

Admins can use Claude to analyze support metrics and trends, including conversation volume, response times, SLA attainment, CSAT, and workload. You can combine metrics in the same question to investigate patterns, compare periods, and understand what needs attention.


Try asking Claude

* Show me unresolved conversations tagged “Billing” and summarize what’s blocking each one.
* Pull up the latest conversation from @acme.com, summarize the outstanding issues, and create a shared draft addressing the most recent request.
* What login issues did customers report this week? Summarize the common problems.
* Which days had the longest first response times this month, and what was conversation volume like on those days
* What are customers with low CSAT scores most commonly unhappy about this quarter?


Claude can only access the Shared Inboxes you’re part of. It can only perform actions supported by this connector and allowed by your existing role and permissions in Hiver.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hiver Omni to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hiver Omni to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-omni.hiverhq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hiver Omni MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiver Omni lists 18 MCP tools, including create_note, create_shared_draft, get_agent_workload, get_company_support_report, get_conversation, get_conversation_volume, get_csat_report, get_response_performance, get_sentiment_summary, get_sla_report, list_conversations, and list_inbox_users.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hiver Omni?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hiver Omni in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and DevRev.

_published_faq.name: Does Hiver Omni MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiver Omni requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hiver Omni is developed by GREXIT, INC.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
